minutes.headline: Conservation Commission approved several wetland filings, a revised Cowry ADA trail plan advanced, and $950 Hollis Road electrical work was approved.
minutes.summary: The commission heard a run of wetlands hearings, approving or issuing negative determinations on most, with conditions, and continuing others. It reviewed a revised ADA trail and parking plan at the Cowry Nature Center and heard concerns from a resident about the Unitil substation project. It also adopted the 2027 meeting schedule and approved an electrician quote for the Hollis Road house.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment; none offered.

Resident of 102 Lemonster Road raised concerns about Unitil's past vegetation clearing, standing water, invasives, unremoved felled trees and lack of right-of-way maintenance near the substation project.

votes.motion: Approve minutes of the previous meeting with corrections noted.
votes.outcome: passed 5-0 by roll call (all members present said I)

votes.motion: Negative determination for retaining wall replacement at 392 Sunset Lane.
votes.outcome: roll call started; superseded by re-vote with conditions

votes.motion: Negative determination for 392 Sunset Lane with conditions (turbidity curtain if water remains in work area, erosion and sedimentation controls).
Approve septic replacement at 134 Peninsula Drive with added condition for an additional understory planting near the water.
Approve project modification at 134 Crawford Street (chain link fence in place of berm).
votes.outcome: failed or withdrawn (Mary Wilson voted no); re-voted after conditions

votes.motion: Rescind the previous vote on the Crawford Street project change.
Approve the project change with fence 6-8 in above ground, no return, and boulders where the return would have been.
Vote to push the Cowry ADA parking and trail plan to the planning board.
Continue Cowry Nature Center notice of intent to November 4, 2026.
Approve Unitil substation notice of intent with conditions: former substation removed and revegetated, ENF certificate recorded with the order, and specified plan approved.
Continue 404 Page Street notice of intent to November 18, 2026.
Negative determination for retaining wall at 3 Wilderwood Avenue, with condition that the string and object in the water be removed.
Continue 143 Island Road notice of intent to November 4, 2026.
Continue 386 Sunset Lane notice of intent to November 4, 2026.
Approve notice of intent at 37 Fire Road 10 per plan dated 9/16/2026, last revised October 13, 2026.
Issue certificate of compliance at 48 Island Road per agent recommendation.
Issue certificate of compliance at 199 Mass Ave.
Approve notice of project change at 791 Lemonster Road as a field change.
Continue 1168 Mass Ave rear enforcement matter to November 18, 2026.
Approve the 2027 meeting schedule.
Approve $950 electrician quote for Hollis Road residence electrical work.
Adjourn.

budget_items.what_was_said: Commission discussed buying metal dog-waste trail signs from Walmart versus custom town-logo signs from a local sign maker or Monty Tech, and asked the agent to get quotes.
Work continues using a paint purchase approved at the previous meeting, with colors and flooring choices discussed.
The electrician quote covers tamperproof receptacles, GFI outlets, a bathroom exhaust fan and closet light fixtures; it was approved.
The agent will propose a non-benefited caretaker/custodian position for the conservation property at Town Meeting for addition to the SAP.
A member described a proposed fee based on impervious surface compared with funding through taxes, ahead of a non-binding Town Meeting question.
The ADA trail project is grant-funded and the grant cannot be extended further, so the schedule is tight.

decisions.decision: Applicant to incorporate commission comments and submit to the planning board, DEP and Natural Heritage at the same time, returning in two weeks.
Agent to get quotes from two vendors for trail dog-waste signs based on the design a member shared; an artist may be asked for a design in November.
Agent to order the camel stone carpet, the Birkshire oak vinyl and Swiss coffee Benjamin Moore paint for the Hollis Road house.
2027 meeting schedule will not be posted in the ledger; it will go on the town web page.
Notice of project change at 134 Crawford Street taken out of agenda order.

what_happened.line: The commission approved the Unitil substation notice of intent with conditions, including removal and revegetation of the former substation, 5-0.
The commission approved a negative determination with conditions for 392 Sunset Lane, and approved a septic replacement at 134 Peninsula Drive with an added planting condition, both 5-0.
After a first vote failed, the commission rescinded it and approved the 134 Crawford Street project change with a fence and boulders, 5-0.
The Cowry Nature Center ADA trail and parking plan was sent to the planning board and the notice of intent continued; the grant cannot be extended.
The commission approved the 2027 meeting schedule and an amount as heard electrician quote for the Hollis Road house, both 5-0.

why_it_matters: Approvals on the Unitil substation, septic and retaining-wall filings set the conditions that shape work near wetlands and water in Lunenburg.
The Cowry trail project is grant-funded and the grant cannot be extended, so delays in review risk the funding for an accessible trail on town conservation land.
Hollis Road house spending, a proposed caretaker position for Town Meeting and a stormwater fee question touch town property costs and possibly a future fee or tax vote.
